evidence: Conditional price-level experiments on the nine fixed-price portfolios. Spending allocation, supply response and basket valuation are uncalibrated sensitivities, not forecasts or probabilities.
unit: U retains its established meaning as the general economic unit. Dimensionless indices are normalized to 100 for each portfolio/window counterfactual; no absolute USD-to-U conversion is made.
boundary: The entire currently planned economic zone beyond Earth through enclosed development, before the Open Moon, planetary array and subsequent outer Solar System buildout. Earth stakeholders remain in the return account.
baseline_valuation: Producer domestic final-use imputation, including its illustrative 30 USD2041/U convention; this is not a market exchange rate or observed expenditure. Basket multipliers test 0.5 and 2 times that valuation.
reading_rule: Indices compare each dated portfolio with its own no-additional-spending/supply counterfactual. They are not annual inflation rates or an index path from year zero. Read assumptions beside every result. Full financial paths reproduce the saved strategy summaries exactly; pricing does not feed back into them.
